# DX12 Guidance

DX12 is the only runtime renderer. Do not add OpenGL or DX11 runtime
dependencies.

Renderer, shader, texture, screenshot, resource-barrier, descriptor, upload, or
root-signature changes require `tools\validate_dx12_renderer.bat` at the
PR/commit gate. Check `dx12_validation.txt` for zero validation errors.
